_comment: Per-test bandit LOW ceilings. A single total was gameable: you could add
30 new try_except_pass and stay under the cap by deleting 30 subprocess
imports. Each test id now ratchets independently -- any of them may fall,
B110 (try_except_pass) is the one that matters most: an undocumented
`except Exception: pass` is the exact fail-open shape this repo keeps
getting bitten by. It is capped here so it cannot grow while the cleanup
happens file by file. 250 -> 244: the six chmod sites that silently left
sensitive files world-readable now go through arena.fileperms.restrict.
make_release_zip.py ships all three and the gate had never looked at two
of them (#242: 6 HIGH and 21 MEDIUM found there, now fixed or annotated).
Every ceiling below is the measured combined count -- the rise is scope,
not new debt. B605 is one os.system('clear') with a fixed literal; B107
is two `token: str = ''` defaults, not credentials. Both verified by hand.
v4.169.x: scope is arena/ + scripts/ + bin/ + skills/ -- every tree
make_release_zip.py ships, derived from its own should_exclude() rather
than hand-listed (#242, #244). It was arena/ only, hiding 7 HIGH and 22
MEDIUM. The rise is scope, not new debt: every finding predates the
change and was simply never looked at.
